The '''Vonak Light Laser Cannon''' was a [[Laser cannon/Legends|light laser cannon]] made by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. It cost 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed 2 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]].
